increment_paragraph: **LIBRDKAFKA-HEADER-INLINES** (USER REQUEST 2026-11-05, verbatim: "Now, we're still needed to fill the gap of the missing contracts."; round 16, card 5 of the contract-gap queue): a census of the uncontracted callees with no body in the user's `quirin-audit current` run at Fluent Bit 046accf6 that librdkafka units call (report sha256 e965950e...d017f): 260 callees, 1,014 pairs. 89 (629 pairs) are librdkafka's own `static` header definitions, byte-identical at 046accf6, 66910c10 and 34155955; all have internal linkage, so gateway constraint 4a already offers them to W4 and no linkage reading applies: their bodies do not validate (the writers reach the cross-unit rd_buf_write, the queues rd_kafka_op_destroy). The rest are owned elsewhere (libc/builtins 22, OpenSSL 68, libcurl 56, zstd 7, zlib 5, Cyrus SASL 4, function-pointer objects 8, one declared name). New resource-v1 module `librdkafka/header_inlines.qv` in qcore-provider-librdkafka: 59 declarations stated from the bodies and pinned at 66910c10 and 046accf6 (524 pairs): the request-buffer writers and updaters (borrowed buffer; its growth ends earlier borrows by C04.3.4), rd_kafkap_str_new/_bytes_new and rd_kafka_partition_leader_new (owned, nullable), rd_kafka_q_enq/_reenq and rd_kafka_msgq_enq (the op or message consumed: on every exit linked into a queue or destroyed, a disabled queue's reply-or-destroy included; no return-code split, since 1 can follow a destruction on a forward queue), five queue and seven message-queue helpers, accessors, borrowed results (rd_kafka_msgq_first/_last, rd_kafka_topic_partition_toppar, rd_tmpabuf_alloc0), rd_kafka_rkt_get_lw (alias or NULL) and utilities; twelve name rk_plugin_callback_closure per the plugin-premise census rerun on the module (eight rk-conf, four indirect). Undeclared with the missing form named: 27 callees, 84 pairs (member-path reference keeps and drops, structs by value, a removal from a borrowed container, rule 13a/13d body shapes, member releases); the rd_atomic32_* primitives (21 pairs) stay REFCOUNT-PLAIN-COUNTER-DECLARATION's. Selected modules 66 -> 67, v1 declarations 499 -> 558, corpus modules 147 -> 148; no analyzer or Lean change. Controls: crates/qcore-c-gateway/tests/librdkafka_header_inlines.rs. Predicted: corpus +6 Safe (rd_slice_crc32, rd_kafka_share_fetch_fanout_enqueue, rd_kafka_share_record_poll_start, rd_kafka_buf_upgrade_flexver_request, rd_kafka_queue_yield, rd_kafka_toppar_needs_query), system and slice none; on the current run 59 callees and 524 pairs leave the uncontracted list and the only-uncontracted rows go 508 -> 502, no unit status change. Records: LIBRDKAFKA-HEADER-INLINES-RESIDUAL and PROVIDER-TESTS-BOUNDS-VIEW-PIN-STALE registered; REFCOUNT-MEMBER-REFERENCE-DROP, REFCOUNT-PLAIN-COUNTER-DECLARATION, W46-HEADER-INLINE-DECLARED-UNCHECKED, W45-SUB-OBJECT-STORE-FORMAL-VALUE, W48-OPENSSL-CONTRACT-PLUGIN, W48-LIBCURL-CONTRACT-PLUGIN and W44-CALLEE-NO-CORPUS-BODY amended. Report: docs/reports/librdkafka-header-inlines/README.md.

ledger.title: 19 librdkafka header definitions stay undeclared behind a named vocabulary or body-check gap: 40 pairs on the current route
ledger.text: Registered by LIBRDKAFKA-HEADER-INLINES (census of the user's `quirin-audit current` run at Fluent Bit 046accf6, docs/reports/librdkafka-header-inlines/census/). Each is a `static` header definition, identical at 046accf6, 66910c10 and 34155955, whose body the run publishes no summary for. A struct passed or returned by value, which no ABI projection admits (5 callees, 15 pairs): rd_kafka_idemp_get_pid0 7 (rd_kafka_pid_t), rd_kafka_replyq_make 3 (also a queue keep inside the struct), rd_kafka_offset_store0 3 (the parameter `const rd_kafka_fetch_pos_t pos`; it also replaces a member allocation), rd_kafka_topic_partition_get_fetch_pos 1, rd_slice_pos 1; this is the gap CFL-MPACK-EXTERNAL-DECLARATIONS registers as MPACK-STRUCT-RESULT-BY-VALUE, and these five move there when that card lands. A body shape the structural checks would withdraw in every including unit: rd_kafka_topic_partition_get_toppar 5 (a returned reference kept by a statement on a local assigned from rd_kafka_topic_partition_ensure_toppar; rule 13d), rd_segment_write_remains 3 (its out slot is null-tested before the write; rule 13a), rd_kafka_q_last 1 and rd_sockaddr_list_next 1 (a borrowed result found by a list walk or an array index; rule 13a reads member paths only). No v1 form: rd_avl_find 3 (an element the tree indexes but does not own), rd_getenv 2 (getenv's storage or the argument), rd_tmpabuf_destroy 1, rd_avg_destroy 1 and rd_avg_rollover 1 (a member released or replaced), rd_kafka_broker_active_toppar_next 1 (a retention by the caller's broker, retention-undecided at every call). Not declared on review: rd_file_mkstemp 2 (a stream result whose body leaks the mkstemp descriptor when fdopen fails), rd_kafka_q_io_event 1 (the queue event-callback invocation itself; its candidates need a C04.19 registry declaration), rd_tmpabuf_write0 1 and rd_tmpabuf_write_str0 2 (they forward rd_tmpabuf_alloc0's borrowed result, now declared, which W4 may infer under C04.3.4 rule 6; measure first). Also: the twelve new uses of rk_plugin_callback_closure in librdkafka/header_inlines.qv state the premise plainly, with no symbolic decomposition or binding-manifest metadata (premise-symbolic-adoption); adding it means extending crates/qcore-contract/tests/production_symbolic_adoption.rs's adoption records. DISCHARGE: per callee, the named form or check (with Lean where semantics change), or a resource-v1 declaration stated from the body and pinned, measured with a declared prediction; the premise metadata adopted for the twelve.

ledger.title: providers/tests' real-manifest test fails at main and runs in no gate step
ledger.text: Found by LIBRDKAFKA-HEADER-INLINES at base 945c0db1b: `python3 -m unittest discover -s providers/tests` fails one test, test_contract_load_path.LoadPathManifest.test_the_real_workspace_manifest_is_current (providers/tests/test_contract_load_path.py:610). Its literal table of non-empty bounds views omits qcore-provider-libevent's monkey/result_range.qv, which card CELL-GUARD-RESULT-RANGE-CHECKED added to that crate's bounds view. The card did not change any bounds view. Neither the scoped card gate (scripts/gate_scope.py: the Python step is `unittest discover -s scripts/tests`, and the provider gate is package build/verify plus the provider workspace's cargo test, fmt and clippy) nor the full gate runs providers/tests, so the stale pin went unseen; the same pattern was recorded once before in that test's own comment (PROVIDER-LOAD-PATH-VIEW-PIN-STALE). DISCHARGE: update the literal (or read it from the inventory locks, as the resource views already are), and put providers/tests into a gate step so a stale pin fails a landing.

AMENDED (LIBRDKAFKA-HEADER-INLINES, 2026-11-05): librdkafka's reply-queue and enq-once header helpers are the same gap at a member path, 7 callees and 39 pairs on the user's current run at 046accf6, none declarable: rd_kafka_replyq_destroy 21 (drops the reference replyq->q holds; C04.17 drops only the object a parameter designates, and C04.19.6's #released releases the member's object rather than one reference of it), rd_kafka_op_set_replyq 7 (keeps a queue reference into rko->rko_replyq: a keep into a non-plain place is refused), rd_kafka_replyq_enq 3 (takes the member's reference over, enqueues, drops it), and rd_kafka_enq_once_del_source 3, _del_source_return 2, _disable 2, _destroy 1 (an eonce reference drop whose family has no declared constructor or keep, plus the member reply queue's drop; two hand back the op the eonce held). Discharge extended: a reference keep and drop at a member path of a parameter.

AMENDED (LIBRDKAFKA-HEADER-INLINES, 2026-11-05): on the user's current run at 046accf6 the three primitives are header definitions with no summary, reported uncontracted in 21 pairs (rd_atomic32_add 10, rd_atomic32_sub 6, rd_atomic32_set 5); the card left them undeclared under C04.17 and declared only the 64-bit rd_atomic64_set beside rd_atomic64_add/_get (rd_refcnt_t is 32-bit).

AMENDED (LIBRDKAFKA-HEADER-INLINES): 59 more such declarations in librdkafka/header_inlines.qv (qcore-provider-librdkafka), each a `static` header definition of librdkafka read at 046accf6, 66910c10 and 34155955 and pinned at 66910c10 and 046accf6 (the request-buffer writers, rd_kafka_q_enq, rd_kafkap_str_new, ...; 524 pairs on the user's current run). Where an including unit's W4 derivation validates a body, C06.4 checks the declaration against it; the borrowed results are checked structurally by rule 13a; otherwise each is an unchecked premise pinned to the header text.

AMENDED (LIBRDKAFKA-HEADER-INLINES, 2026-11-05): librdkafka's rd_kafka_msgq_deq (rdkafka_msg.h:372-385, 5 pairs on the user's current run at 046accf6) is the same removal side: it unlinks a message from a borrowed queue and hands it to the caller, which `resource_return_removed` (an owned parent) cannot state and an alias result would leave unowned; it stays undeclared. Its insert, rd_kafka_msgq_enq, is declared consuming the message.
